description.value: Port-O-Call Inn & Suites is a 42-unit motel on Terminal Avenue North in Nanaimo, positioned minutes from the city's ferry terminals and major highway routes. Part of the Roadside Hospitality portfolio, it offers four room categories ranging from standard queens to family suites, all equipped with mini fridges, microwaves, and coffee machines, with suites adding a full kitchenette. The property markets itself to ferry travellers, road trippers, and extended-stay guests including snowbirds, making it a practical stopover point on Vancouver Island.
